2014_spells.ceremony.description: You perform a special religious ceremony that is infused with magic. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following rites: Atonement, Bless Water, Coming of Age, Dedication, Funeral Rite, Wedding. The target of the rite gains a specific benefit as described in the spell's full text.
2014_spells.ceremony.effectSummary: Change a target: the target of the rite gains a specific benefit as described in the spell's full text
2014_spells.ceremony.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you perform a special religious ceremony that is infused with magic. The target of the rite gains a specific benefit as described in the spell's full text. The effect happens immediately and then ends; you can cast it as a ritual.
